The right transport mode, at the right price.
Sea, air, full container, road or rail: compare indicative prices before you even request a quotation, then track your goods step by step from your client area.
Four ways to ship your goods
We tell you frankly which one we recommend.
The cheapest, and the one we recommend.
The fastest. For a small package that is urgent or valuable.

Indicative prices in RMB per chargeable kilo, delivered with duties and taxes included: we compare the actual weight with the volume converted into kilos, and the higher of the two is used as the basis. Large parcels and pallets: from 10.3 RMB/kg by sea and 47 RMB/kg by air, depending on the destination. Full container, road and rail: on quotation. The actual price is shown separately on your quotation.

Our own logistics in Dongguan, partners all over China

Our in-house logistics is in Dongguan. Our logistics partners cover China’s major cities, and your shipments leave from the major ports: Nansha, the largest, Xiamen, and the ports of the north and south.
Diagram: our in-house logistics in Dongguan, linked to our partners in Guangzhou, Foshan and China’s major cities
How much would your shipment cost?
Enter your cartons: we calculate the chargeable weight (dimensions ÷ 6,000) and compare the four modes. The price appears once you’ve signed up for free.
The higher of the two applies
Prices for all four modes, side by side
The breakdown: freight, product surcharge, reinforcement
Your estimate saved, ready to become a quotation
A guide, not a firm price: the actual price is shown separately on your quotation.
Follow every step, without having to ask us
Every order moves through four statuses. In your client area, a route map and a list of steps show you where it stands.
Receiving, inspection and consolidation at the warehouse, then ready to load.
Balance paid, container loaded, export documents issued.
At sea, then arrival in port and customs clearance.
Why do you recommend sea freight?

It’s the cheapest mode: 10.9 to 20.5 RMB per kilo for your parcels, from 10.3 RMB for large parcels and pallets. Road and rail freight are priced on quotation and we don’t recommend them; road freight is riskier.
Tell us about your next order.
You’ll receive a detailed quotation within 24 to 72 hours, in French, English or Chinese.
